challenges.title: 7-Day Consistency Sprint
challenges.description: Complete at least one scheduled habit every day for 7 consecutive days to spark rapid momentum.
challenges.rule_description: Log any scheduled habit every day. Grace period allows catchup before challenge end.

challenges.title: 14-Day Discipline Sprint
challenges.description: Execute your core daily routines without missing a day for two full weeks.
challenges.rule_description: STRICT: Complete all scheduled daily habits every single day without interruption.

challenges.title: 21-Day Neural Habit Builder
challenges.description: Forge permanent neural pathways with 21 days of continuous daily discipline.
challenges.rule_description: Accumulate 21 completed days across your active habits before the sprint deadline.

challenges.title: 30-Day No-Zero-Days Quest
challenges.description: Never allow a single zero day. Complete at least one key priority habit every single calendar day for a full month.
challenges.rule_description: STRICT: Zero days permitted. If any calendar day has 0 completions, the quest breaks and fails.

challenges.title: Early Riser Challenge
challenges.description: Win the morning by executing your morning routines before 8:00 AM for 14 straight days.
challenges.rule_description: STRICT: Execute your morning-scheduled routine each day unbroken.

challenges.title: Digital Detox & Mindful Focus
challenges.description: Protect your mental bandwidth by executing daily screen-free mindfulness and reflection for 7 days.
challenges.rule_description: STRICT: Log your mindfulness or reflection routine every day without skipping.

challenges.title: Deep Work Mastery Sprint
challenges.description: Execute deep focused work sessions every day for 21 days to achieve breakthrough professional output.
challenges.rule_description: STRICT: Log focused work/study habits every day with zero missed days.

challenges.title: Iron Consistency: Workout Sprint
challenges.description: Log active physical movement, gym workouts, or fitness training consistently for 4 weeks.
challenges.rule_description: STRICT: Log at least one fitness session on every scheduled active day.

challenges.title: 14-Day Reading Challenge
challenges.description: Read at least 15 minutes or 10 pages daily to broaden your mind and compound knowledge.
challenges.rule_description: Complete daily reading sessions across 14 days.

challenges.title: Hydration 8-Glass Odyssey
challenges.description: Drink at least 8 glasses (2 Liters) of water daily to maintain peak hydration and sustained stamina.
challenges.rule_description: Hit your daily hydration targets for 14 calendar days.

challenges.title: 10-Day Meditation & Stillness
challenges.description: Cultivate emotional poise and inner stillness with 10 days of intentional mindfulness practice.
challenges.rule_description: Log daily stillness or meditation sessions for 10 days.

challenges.title: 30-Day Custom Mastery Sprint
challenges.description: Dedicate 30 days of focused effort to your personal priority habit and forge mastery.
challenges.rule_description: Complete your chosen priority habits consistently over 30 days.
